description: This file contains unit tests specifically for validating LDAP synchronization functionalities within the LDAP service of the OrangeHRM system. It tests handling of LDAP entries and enforces validation rules such as attribute presence, length constraints, and email format for LDAP users, ensuring robust LDAP user data synchronization.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceFieldValidationTest
classes.description: Unit test class for validating LDAP synchronization and user attribute validation logic.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Test method that verifies correct handling and validation of LDAP user attributes, including length and format constraints, during synchronization.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Helper method that creates a mocked LDAP EntryCollection object from provided LDAP entries and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Generates a set of mock LDAP Entry objects representing various user entries with different attribute validity and length constraints.
